verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is offered as a hosted service, with multi-tenant cloud as the default and single-tenant or BYOC as options [docs-3]. Developers work with it entirely through official SDKs and API tokens [docs-39, docs-35], and the namespace is the database unit. Namespaces can be listed, branched, copied across regions/clouds and spun up per test through the API [docs-27, docs-23, docs-33, docs-37], which amounts to programmatic provisioning in a serverless model, and namespace pinning provisions reserved compute [docs-26]. missing for 10: programmatic API-key/token creation (tokens are created in the dashboard), a documented API for provisioning single-tenant/BYOC deployments, an explicit statement of how namespaces are created, independent hands-on corroboration.
